summary: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude from gross income certain discharges of indebtedness secured by commercial or retail real property, provided the debt was incurred before March 1, 2023, and discharged between December 31, 2023, and January 1, 2028.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to exclude certain discharges of commercial or retail indebtedness from taxable income. By reducing the amount of income subject to taxation for specific businesses, it effectively lowers their tax burden, thus representing a form of tax reduction.

The bill creates a new exclusion from gross income under IRC section 108 for discharges of qualified commercial or retail real-property indebtedness between 2023 and 2028. This directly reduces federal tax revenue for the affected years, increasing the deficit relative to current law.
